desc: Factorize all $A_i$ to identify unique primes involved and their exponents $c_{i,p} = v_p(A_i)$.
For each unique prime $p$, construct a DP to calculate the sum of products of exponents sequence $x_1, \dots, x_N$ satisfying $|x_i - x_{i+1}| = c_{i,p}$ and $\min x_i = 0$.

In the DP for a prime $p$, iterate through possible "relative" configurations of the sequence defined by the choices of signs $\delta_j \in \{c_{i,p}, -c_{i,p}\}$. Calculate the required starting value $x_1$ to satisfy the minimum constraint, then compute the product of terms $(x_1 + \text{prefix}_k)$ and sum these up.
Multiply the results from all primes modulo 998244353 to get the final answer.
Implement the solution in Python, reading from stdin and printing to stdout.
Run the code against Sample 1, Sample 2, and Sample 3 to verify correctness.
Ensure modulo arithmetic is applied correctly at each step.
